profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer & AI Team Lead at Walmart Inc.
profile.jobTitle: Staff Software Engineer & AI Team Lead
profile.summary:
Most engineers are handed a problem to solve. I find the problem behind the problem, and I build the system that makes sure no one has to solve it again. On every team I have joined, I have been the one who notices the friction others have made peace with: the manual step nobody questions, the brittle process no one dares touch, the hours bleeding quietly out of every week.

As an engineering leader with more than eleven years of engineering experience across Walmart, Intel, and Apple, I drive technical roadmaps and high-scale backend architecture. Most recently, I led a team of 4 engineers to pioneer an agentic AI on-call platform that resolves production incidents on its own, behind a strict safety model, giving on-call teams their nights back. Before that, I architected an advertising campaign and billing service that administers more than $10 billion in campaigns and over $300 million in monthly invoices, cutting $26 million in annual costs and improving performance by 70%. My focus never changes: find the work a team has resigned itself to, and engineer it away.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer & AI Team Lead
positions.description:
• Identified a critical operational gap and led 4 engineers to pioneer an Agentic AI on-call platform from concept to production, resolving incidents 85% faster across Walmart & Sam’s Club, saving $350M and 6M+ hours annually
• Established safety guardrails with fail-closed controls and a plug-and-play MCP layer for 100+ tools to triage, remediate, verify, and close incidents, using pgvector (Vector DB) RAG for runbook & past-incident retrieval
• Directed a team of 3 engineers leading end-to-end architecture of a new ad campaign service which manages over $10B in campaign value across first- and third-party advertisers, campaigns, line items, and creatives
• Led cross-functional design meetings and stakeholder management to identify consumer use cases and tailored the new APIs with specific implementations improving performance and scalability by >70%
• Governed billing data pipelines generating $3.6B in annual invoices, driving CI/CD and AutoCRQ enablement
• Architected P&G invoice data integration utilizing REST API and SFTP protocols for Walmart’s largest advertiser ensuring seamless data flow and billing accuracy
• Engineered the Walmart Credit Memo and Rebill functionality as the sole contributor managing implementation and release for critical financial adjustment services
• Championed the implementation of CI/CD pipelines and repository migrations to resolve operational fragmentation and improve deployment stability across all repositories using Agile methodologies
• Optimized system reliability by configuring advanced Grafana dashboards and automated alerting for billing environments to improve incident detection and response times
positions.insights: Skills: Groovy · Agile Methodologies · Back-End Web Development · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Distributed Systems · JIRA Software · Scalability · Technical Leadership · Jenkins · Stakeholder Management · MongoDB · System Architecture · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Software Development · Microservices · MySQL · Mentoring · Play Framework · Scala

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Partnered with team leadership on resource planning and level-of-effort scoping across critical projects, directing and mentoring 3 engineers with sprint roadmaps to ensure 100% on-time platform release delivery
• Led delivery of a full-stack server platform using Node.js, React, GraphQL, and Docker while automating rolling restarts and maintenance pipelines to eliminate monthly downtime and 98% of manual workflows
• Engineered high-performance Python automation to address server management efficiency and scalability reducing manual workflows by 98%
• Pioneered internal educational initiatives by hosting Python classes to mentor colleagues on data structures syntax and algorithms for high-efficiency scripting
• Strategized with cross-functional management to define new back-end methodologies that reduced assembly errors by 90% while improving data archiving standards
• Optimized technical workflows and infrastructure through Python and Perl automation achieving a reduction in circuit verification bottlenecks from 5 days to 2 hours
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Back-End Web Development · Electronics · Distributed Systems · Python (Programming Language) · GraphQL · JIRA Software · Scalability · Technical Leadership · Stakeholder Management · System Architecture · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Project Management · Software Development · Digital Electronics · Microservices · MySQL · VLSI · React.js · Mentoring · Node.js

positions.title: ASIC Design Engineer II - Full Chip
positions.description:
• Supervised end-to-end delivery across 5 flagship chips powering iPhone, iPad, and MacBook products, coordinating frontend, analog, P&R, CAD, and packaging teams from floorplan to final tapeout signoff
• Chaired design automation meetings with CAD teams and EDA vendors to drive multi-year tooling roadmaps
• Strategized product chip area reduction by 1.5mm squared for pad-limited designs resulting in lower power leakage and cost savings
• Built pushbutton CAD automation flows, cutting bump and RDL handoff runtime from 1 week to 5 hou
• Verified full-chip ESD bump and bonding pad to clamp resistance checks and performed final tapeout signoffs
• Identified and flagged systematic DRC conflicts and shorts to flow owners to prevent critical tapeout setbacks
• Implemented top-level bump and RDL designs in advanced nodes including 7nm 10nm and 16nm for future generation products
positions.insights: Skills: Electronics · Python (Programming Language) · JIRA Software · Technical Leadership · Stakeholder Management · Project Management · Digital Electronics · VLSI

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Piloted a unified Perl script project for performing lexical analysis on circuit netlists to accelerate PDK development
• Optimized file syntax extraction using Perl regex operations resulting in up to 80% runtime improvement
• Enhanced 16nm and 10nm FinFET devices using Cadence Virtuoso GXL for cell designs and DRC LVS simulations
• Contributed to technical seminars exploring semiconductor physics and devices beyond Moore’s Law

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Led a Java-based software-hardware interface project improving data monitoring by 90% during off-site radiation tests
• Mentored team members in Cadence Virtuoso and educated the group on the importance of minimal metal line parasitics
• Organized logistics and itineraries for monthly $50,000 radiation tests for military and aerospace devices
• Received a corporate award of $1,600 for outstanding pre-planning and logistical coordination
• Mitigated latch-up on SoC FPGAs in radiation environments by >50% and proposed SEU and SEL mitigation solutions
• Developed dynamically allocated GUI interfaces in Java to remotely collect data and control hardware devices
• Verified HDLs with test benches and pre/post synthesis simulations using Libero SoC and ModelSim
